REPORT
File No. __________
Date February 18th 35.

Subject (in full) Case against Mrs. Rosa Brodskaya.

Made by D.S.I. Utkin Forwarded by [Signature]

On January 19, 1935, a Russian female named Mary Kosyh, residing
in 27, Tracey Terrace, reported to the French Police that in
October 1934 she had been sold for $ 100.00 to a brothel in Hankow
owned by a Russian named Ephim Roudyh by a Russian Jewess named
Rosa Brodskaya, age 59, residing in No.2, passage 88, Route Vallon.
On the following day Mrs. Rosa Brodskaya, widow of the notorious
criminal Abram Brodsky, who was murdered in Harbin on 2-6-33,
was taken into custody and detained on a writ of Detention.
Subsequent enquiries by the French Police disclosed the follo-
wing:
A Russian female named Luba Ivanova was sold by Mrs. Brodskaya
to a brothel-keeper in Hankow. A letter incriminating the accused
was produced in Court.
Mrs. Tatiana Voiseeva, Russian, age 22, residing in No.3, Lane
134, Route Vallon stated that during 1934 Mrs. Brodskaya had per-
suaded her to join a brothel operated by Mrs. Louise Dent on
Connaught Road.
Mrs. Helen Panova, Russian, residing in No.12, Linda Terrace,
stated that Mrs. Brodskaya had received $ 20.00 commission from a
brothel-keeper at 360, Route Tenant de la Tour, and later another
$ 20.00 commission from Mrs. Victoria Seou, then brothel-keeper at
210, Avenue du Roi Albert, for having taken her to the houses of
these women.
On the strength of the above evidence Mrs. Brodskaya was charged
under Art's 246, 248 and 313 of C.C.R.C., offences against Morality
and Personal Liberty, and appeared before the 2nd S.D.C. on 28-1-35
and again on 6-2-35 when the case was remanded pending appearance
of other witnesses. Mrs. Brodskaya was allowed bail in the sum of
$ 1000.00 shop or cash security.

Deputy Commissioner ( Special Branch).
[Signature]
Information.

日期 1935年2月18日。

主题（全称） 针对罗莎·布罗德斯卡娅夫人的案件。

由 D.S.I. Utkin 编制 经 [签名] 转呈

1935年1月19日，一名居住在 Tracey Terrace 27号的俄国女子玛丽·科西赫（Mary Kosyh）向法国警察报案称，1934年10月，她被一名居住在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）88弄2号的59岁俄国犹太女子罗莎·布罗德斯卡娅（Rosa Brodskaya）以100美元的价格卖给了汉口一家由名为埃菲姆·鲁迪赫（Ephim Roudyh）的俄国人经营的妓院。次日，臭名昭著的罪犯阿布拉姆·布罗德斯基（Abram Brodsky）的遗孀罗莎·布罗德斯卡娅夫人被捕，阿布拉姆·布罗德斯基于1933年2月6日在哈尔滨被谋杀。她依据拘留令被羁押。法国警察随后的调查披露了以下情况：
一名名为卢巴·伊万诺娃（Luba Ivanova）的俄国女子被布罗德斯卡娅夫人卖给了汉口的一名妓院老板。法庭上出示了一封指控被告的信件。
居住在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）134弄3号的22岁俄国女子塔蒂亚娜·沃伊谢耶娃（Tatiana Voiseeva）夫人陈述称，1934年间，布罗德斯卡娅夫人曾劝说她加入路易丝·登特（Louise Dent）夫人在康纳路（Connaught Road）经营的一家妓院。
居住在 Linda Terrace 12号的俄国女子海伦·帕诺娃（Helen Panova）夫人陈述称，布罗德斯卡娅夫人因将她带至这些女子的住所，从 Tenant de la Tour 路360号的一名妓院老板那里收取了20美元佣金，后来又从当时居住在阿尔伯特王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert）210号的妓院老板维多利亚·修（Victoria Seou）夫人那里收取了另一笔20美元佣金。
基于上述证据，布罗德斯卡娅夫人被依据《中华民国刑法》第246、248及313条指控犯有妨害风化及侵犯人身自由罪，并于1935年1月28日及2月6日两次出庭受审于上海第二特区地方法院，当时案件因等待其他证人出庭而被延期审理。布罗德斯卡娅夫人获准保释，保证金为1000美元，以店铺担保或现金担保。

特科副督察长。
[签名]
情报。
JHS

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 7, 1935
9985

Girls Insist
They Were Sold
As Prostitutes

Russian Woman Denies
She Collected Debts
By Bawdy House Sales

Persistent denials of police charges on behalf of two Russian girls concerning trafficking in girls, were made by Mrs. Roza Brodsky, 37, a resident of House No. 2, passage 88, Route Vallon, at a resumed hearing before Judge Chiu of the Second Special District Court yesterday morning. Except for the presence of Miss Marie Kosh, one of the two complainants, no other witnesses were in court. After a legal fight between the two opposing lawyers, the court ordered session concluded pending judgment on February 12.

The prosecution, under the con-duction of Mr. S. H. Kou on behalf of Marie Kosh and Helene Panova, Russians, said yesterday that Mrs. Brodsky had actually decoyed girls to be sold to ill-fame houses in this locality, and to others in outports, under the guise of selling articles to cabaret girls. / The lawyer said that altogether six girls, including the two now present, have been sold as result of her conspiracy with bawdy house operators. The other girls, now being in outports, could not appear in court as witnesses.

Ross Brodsky used to advance money or sell goods on credit to any cabaret dancing girls, and if she could not collect her debts from those girls, she would compel them to join houses of ill-fame, it was declared. In the instances of the complainants, Misses Kosh and Panova, the police stated, Mrs. Brodsky collected her debts from operators of bawdy houses both in Shanghai and Hankow where the two girls were sold there. Mrs. Brodsky obtained $100 from one Mr. T. Hoodih, a Chinese broker in Hankow out of the sales of Miss Kosh, and got $60 from a Chinese operator of a Bawdy House, whose name is Tou Seng, who Panova was sold. It was stated ...

《字林西报》，1935年2月7日，星期四
9985

女孩们坚持声称
她们被卖为妓女

俄国女子否认
她通过妓院买卖
收取债务

昨天上午，在第二特区地方法院邱法官主持的续审中，37岁的罗莎·布罗德斯基（Roza Brodsky）夫人（居住在瓦隆路 Route Vallon 88弄2号）代表两名涉及贩卖少女案件的俄国女孩，对警方的指控予以坚决否认。除两名原告之一的玛丽·科什（Marie Kosh）小姐外，没有其他证人出庭。经过双方律师的法律辩论后，法院宣布休庭，待2月12日宣判。

昨天，代表俄国女子玛丽·科什和海伦·帕诺娃（Helene Panova）提起公诉的检察官 S. H. Kou 先生称，布罗德斯基夫人实际上是以向歌舞厅女孩推销商品为幌子，诱骗女孩并将她们卖给本地及外埠的妓院。该律师称，由于她与妓院经营者勾结，共有六名女孩被卖，其中包括目前出庭的两名。其他女孩目前身处外埠，无法作为证人出庭。

据称，罗斯·布罗德斯基（Ross Brodsky）曾向任何歌舞厅舞女预支款项或赊销商品，如果她无法从这些女孩那里收回欠款，就会强迫她们进入妓院。警方称，在原告科什小姐和帕诺娃小姐的案例中，布罗德斯基夫人从上海和汉口的妓院经营者那里收回了她的债务，这两名女孩就是被卖到了那里。布罗德斯基夫人从汉口一名中国经纪人 T. Hoodih 先生出售科什小姐的交易中获得了100美元，并从一名中国妓院老板 Tou Seng 处获得了60美元，帕诺娃被卖给了此人。据称……
